name: pull-down-cable-underhand
title: Pull Down: Cable (Underhand)
primer: This is an exercise for lats and biceps strengthening.
steps: Sitting upright with your abs drawn in grasp a Pull Down bar with an underhand grip shoulder width apart.
Pull the bar down until the bar reaches your upper chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Slowly return the bar to the starting position.
